components.name: Pinnate Brand Mark
components.description: Rounded-square ink badge holding a two-pair pinnate leaf with orange Done leaflet (no red pin).
components.html: Pinnate
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-family-base, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-main, #18181b); text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--border-dark, #18181b); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-brand-name { letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary pill action across landing and header navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-full, 9999px); background: var(--border-dark, #18181b); border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dark, #18181b); color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-tactile, ease), background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-ink-hover, #27272a); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-dark, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: Clean paper action control inside workspace toolbars and Scratchpad.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e4e4e7); color: var(--text-main, #18181b); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-tactile, ease), background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #f4f4f5); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-dark, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pinned Note Card
components.description: Tactile pastel note card with red pushpin strictly on pinned state and AA-compliant metadata.
components.html:
Ship v1 roadmap

Keep rough ideas in Scratchpad and move active plans onto the Board.

In Progress2m ago
components.css: .ds-note-card { position: relative; max-width: 300px; background: var(--color-sage-bg, #dcfce7); border: 2px solid var(--card-border, #18181b); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow, 2px 2px 0px rgba(24,24,27,0.85)); padding: 18px 20px; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); font-family: var(--font-family-base, sans-serif); } .ds-note-card:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow-hover, 3px 4px 0px rgba(24,24,27,0.9)); } .ds-pin-dot { position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 20px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--pin-red, #ef4444); border: 2px solid #18181b; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-pin-hole { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--pin-red-hole, #7f1d1d); } .ds-note-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-main, #18181b); } .ds-note-body { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-muted, #52525b); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-note-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; } .ds-stage-pill { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--accent-blue-surface, #f0f9ff); color: var(--accent-blue-text, #0369a1); } .ds-timestamp { color: var(--text-subtle, #5c5c66); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Input Field

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-family-base, sans-serif); max-width: 320px; } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-main, #18181b); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 15px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-subtle, #e4e4e7); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-main, #18181b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-dark, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--border-dark, #18181b); }

narrative.overview: Pinnate combines the tactile honesty of physical paper cards pinned to a clean worktable with quiet software ergonomics. Monochrome paper (#fafafa) and deep carbon ink (#18181b) form a restrained chrome layer so user notes—soft pastel cards and stage movement toward Done—stay the emotional center of gravity.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile paper-on-ink card silhouettes with crisp 1.5px-2px borders and subtle offset ink shadows.
Strict semantic color discipline: blue denotes activity/motion, orange signals Done, and red stays strictly on pinned card pushpins.
Hand-drawn organic details balanced by scannable utility controls and automatic typing pause.

rules.name: The Semantic Restraint Rule
rules.body: Orange means Done and Blue means Active. Never paint generic tape, borders, or uncompleted chrome in orange, and never place a red pushpin on an unpinned card.

rules.name: The Subtle Contrast Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on gray or pastel card fills must maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast using Graphite Subtle (#5c5c66) or Ink Muted (#52525b) — never low-contrast #71717a.

rules.name: The Balance-Without-Stragglers Rule
rules.body: Public headings apply text-wrap: balance and body leads use text-wrap: pretty inside constrained ch measures so single-word orphans never dangle.

rules.name: The No Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Never place a bordered, shadowed note card inside another bordered rounded card container; place tactile cards directly onto open warm paper or borderless tonal composition zones.

dos: Do use plain Pinnate vocabulary everywhere (Pin, Board, Stage, Scratchpad, Progress, Done, Add to notes, Quick add).
Do apply prefers-reduced-motion static fallbacks and pause idle art motion while users focus or type.
Do ensure every interactive control meets >= 44x44px on touch/mobile viewports with descriptive labels.
donts: Don't reintroduce "Tack", "Quick tack", "Desk", "Cloud Desk", "Notes Workspace", or BookOpen brand icons.
Don't put #ef4444 pushpins on unpinned Kanban cards or reuse #ef4444 on error icons (--danger-text #b91c1c owns errors).
Don't ship unconfirmed destructive actions, silent catch blocks, or streak/missed-day guilt metrics.
